headings: (500 ML) PALO SANTO HAND AND BODY LOTION

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) PALO SANTO HAND AND BODY LOTION
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body lotion. Container with a dispenser pump.

Palo Santo | Inspired by a spiritual immersion, a powerful connection to ancestral roots and traditions. A fragrance created with the noblest essence of Palo Santo, enhanced by the spicy touch of black pepper and a delicate veil of violet leaves that complete this unique creation.

Olfactory notes
Top: black pepper, hemp.
Heart: violet, clove.
Base: vetiver, ambergris.
